references.name: Ghazali
references.desc:
Arab moralist who documented students
attending college for wealth rather than
learning -- Glubb's key parallel to modern
Western education

references.name: Ibn Bessam
references.desc:
Arab historian who protested women entering
professions during Baghdad's decline

references.name: Rashid al-Din
references.desc:
Persian historian and Mongol Prime Minister
who exemplifies intellectuals surviving
imperial collapse as servants of conquerors

references.name: Jean Gimpel
references.desc:
Reported the decline of American physical
energy -- executives taking two-hour lunches,
pedestrians walking at Roman pace

references.name: Acts of the Apostles
references.desc:
Biblical description of declining Athenian
intellectualism: citizens spending all time
telling or hearing "some new thing"

references.name: Shakespeare, Julius Caesar
references.desc:
"The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our
stars" -- Glubb's closing appeal that decline
is self-inflicted and therefore reversible

references.name: Blackwood's Magazine
references.desc:
Original venue of publication for both
essays (1976 and December 1976)
